## API Access (for AI agents)
/api/v1/properties: Search properties by city, amenities, price, availability
/api/v1/properties/{id}/availability: Live room availability by date
/api/v1/properties/{id}/rates: Nightly rates by room type
/openapi.json: Full OpenAPI 3.0 specification for agent action groups
